# Vakkeel & Associates

> Vakkeel & Associates is an Indian law firm (advocates & legal counsel) based in
> Nilambur, Kerala, serving clients across India and the global Indian diaspora.
> The firm advises on litigation, commercial, property, family and
> government-approvals/compliance matters.

This file is intended to help large language models and AI agents understand how
this website may be crawled, summarized and used. It follows the llms.txt
convention: Markdown, with a single H1 heading and grouped links.

## Usage

- Public pages of this site may be crawled and used to answer questions about the
  firm, its practice areas and its published legal insights.
- Please do not treat the content on this site as legal advice for a specific
  matter. It is general information; individual situations require a lawyer.
- Privacy and non-public areas (see `robots.txt`) are off limits:
  `/admin/`, `/api/`, `/login`, `/dashboard`, `/onboarding/`, `/preview/`, and any
  URL carrying `?utm_*` or `?preview=` tracking parameters.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.vakkeelandassociates.com/): Firm overview, practice areas and how to book a consultation.
- [Legal Insights](https://www.vakkeelandassociates.com/insights): Articles on practical legal problems and how the firm approaches them.
- [Government Approvals & Compliance](https://www.vakkeelandassociates.com/government-approvals-compliance): Regulatory, licensing and attestation services.
- [Join Us](https://www.vakkeelandassociates.com/join): Careers and advocates joining the practice.

## Practice areas

- NRI All Legal Services
- Government Approvals & Compliance
- Property & Registration
- Family & Matrimonial
- Litigation & Dispute Resolution
- Commercial & Corporate Advisory
